historical_reviews.related_cases: Row97 concerns 1.8V LDO PGOOD; row99 concerns the current limiter. Neither substitutes for high-current-consumption warning coverage.

original_test_intent: Inject a PMIC high-current-consumption warning for every approved DIMM and voltage type, verify the intended correctable warning and OS reporting, and show that current, rail, thermal and memory health return to baseline without protection action.
original_method: Prove railtype10 and parameter semantics; map each DIMM/PMIC/current sensor/I2C path; baseline current, voltage, temperature and warning state; inject one approved tuple; correlate calibrated current and fresh PMIC/CPER/SEL evidence; confirm warning-only behavior, clear timing and no limiter/reset; restore and validate memory before the next target.
manual_activity: The PMIC/power owner defines the railtype10 warning stimulus and safe current envelope, maps each sensor and target, supervises one injection, and restores PMIC, rail, thermal and memory state.
required_inputs: PMIC/tool proof railtype10 selects High Current Consumption Warning and definitions of voltagetype0/1
Warning threshold, duration, hysteresis, latch/clear behavior, correctable/fatal semantics and reset/no-reset policy
Per-DIMM/PMIC socket/die/UMC/channel/slot/dimm, rail and calibrated current-sensor map
Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller/bus/address/OOB path and raw warning/status registers
Command continuation and full target tuple matrix
Normal/warning/limiter/trip current boundaries, thermal/voltage limits, fresh PMIC/CPER/SEL evidence, timeout and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated instrumented SUT with independent OOB, calibrated current/voltage capture and thermal/fan monitoring
Confirm warning target remains below current-limiter, trip and component absolute limits
One target/parameter once; abort on overcurrent, rail droop, unexpected limiter/reset, overheating, bus loss, DIMM/MCA error or missing evidence
Preserve warning/status evidence before approved clear and verify stable rails and current
No automatic target loop; restore PMIC mode/recovery, SPD ownership, telemetry, I2C and HDT
agent_execution_scope: Validate warning identity, severity, target/sensor/I2C matrix, safe envelope and recovery plan
Collect read-only current, voltage, thermal, fan, raw PMIC status, exact timeline, CPER/SEL and memory health
Do not infer threshold/target, modify PMIC/I2C/BIOS/HDT, inject, clear, reset, repeat, recover or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve severity and railtype/parameter semantics; approve target and sensor matrix
Approve safe current thresholds, timing, hysteresis and warning-only oracle
Restore state and issue per-target verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic PMIC/current grep output cannot prove calibrated consumption, warning threshold crossing, target identity or avoidance of limiter/trip.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After railtype10 and safe-current semantics are approved, run one mapped tuple with synchronized current/voltage/thermal capture, correlate target-specific warning evidence, then prove clear and recovery.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: listvalidumc, 0:0:3, railtype10, voltagetype0/1, dimm0, Fatal label, correctable Criteria, all-DIMM scope, PMIC/I2C settings and 360/120-minute values remain preserved as disputed inputs.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute one instrumented high-current warning transition per approved PMIC without entering limiter/trip range, with calibrated telemetry and exact assertion/clear timing.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds current thresholds, sensor calibration, hysteresis, protection boundaries, target/I2C mapping, no-reset policy and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tool PASS and a log line cannot prove physical current entered the intended warning band or avoided limiter and trip behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A real or misconfigured high-current stimulus can overheat power delivery or cause rail droop, shutdown and data corruption.

project_override_considerations: Use independent current measurement rather than assuming PMIC telemetry accuracy during fault injection. I2C access is Wistron BMC/platform-management scope and cannot be inferred from host enumeration.
expected_evidence: Railtype10/parameter/severity specification and physical PMIC/DIMM/current-sensor/I2C topology
Pinned tool/spec with calibrated current, rail, thermal and raw warning baseline
Exact injection with synchronized measured-current and warning assertion/deassertion timeline
Fresh target-specific PMIC/CPER/SEL evidence showing warning without limiter/trip or unapproved reset
Stable current/rails/temperature/fans, cleared warning, DIMM enumeration and clean memory health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure labels the injection Fatal while Criteria says correctable and the item says Warning. All DIMMs and two voltage types are requested from one fixed tuple; railtype10/parameter semantics, warning threshold, hysteresis, command continuation and safe protection boundary are undefined.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The high-current warning intent and seed tuple are identifiable. Engineering can supply the target map and a safe synthetic warning method, so static review completes.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 98 Wistron-System RAS-00818-V002: prove railtype10 is High Current Consumption Warning and define voltagetype0/1; reconcile Fatal label with correctable Warning Criteria and reset/no-reset behavior; map every DIMM/PMIC/current sensor plus Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller/bus/address/OOB path; approve command/tuple matrix, warning/limiter/trip thresholds, duration/hysteresis/latch/clear behavior, safe current/thermal/voltage limits, PMIC/CPER/SEL evidence, memory recovery, aborts and restoration.

review_improvement: Separates high-current warning from current-limiter action and requires calibrated current plus protection-boundary evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A high-current-consumption warning is not proof that a limiter operated. Acceptance needs measured current in an approved warning band, exact PMIC status assertion and clear, and evidence that voltage, temperature and memory remained healthy. The source's Fatal label conflicts with warning/correctable language, and the fixed tuple cannot establish all-DIMM coverage.
